theorem exists_norm_weightedMoment_sub_main_le_general (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {L δ : ℝ}, 16 ≤ L → 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 / 4 → ∀ (ε : ℝ) {n n₀ : ℕ},
      n ≠ 0 → IsSmoothOver P n₀ →
      ‖ZetaNotch.weightedMoment L (notchWeight P ε n₀) (Real.log n) -
          ((((1 + ε ^ 2) * (if vecOf P n = 0 then 1 else 0) +
            ε * (if vecOf P n = vecOf P n₀ then 1 else 0)) * ∏ p : P, (1 - primeHalf p ^ 2)) *
              (Real.sqrt (roughPart P n))⁻¹ : ℝ) * logWindow L‖ ≤
        ∑ j ∈ bohrModes, ∑ c ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : P => bohrModes),
          |modeCoeff ε j c| * hkEnvelope C L δ K
            (vecNum (vecOf P n - (j • vecOf P n₀ + c)) * roughPart P n)
            (vecDen (vecOf P n - (j • vecOf P n₀ + c)))

by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hmain⟩ := exists_norm_twistedMoment_hk_sub_le K
  refine ⟨C, hC, fun {L δ} hL hδ hδ4 ε {n n₀} hn hn₀ => ?_⟩
  have hL0 : 0 < L := by linarith
  set r := roughPart P n with hr
  have hr0 : 0 < r := roughPart_pos hn
  set b : ℤ → (P → ℤ) → (P → ℤ) := fun j c => vecOf P n - (j • vecOf P n₀ + c) with hb
  have hfreq : ∀ j c, Real.log n - modeFreq n₀ j c =
      Real.log ((vecNum (b j c) * r : ℕ) : ℝ) - Real.log (vecDen (b j c)) := by
    intro j c
    have hnum : (0 : ℝ) < vecNum (b j c) := by exact_mod_cast vecNum_pos hP (b j c)
    have hrr : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr0
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, Real.log_mul hnum.ne' hrr.ne', log_eq_smooth_add_rough hP hn,
      ← vecFreq_vecOf_eq_log_smoothPart hP, modeFreq_eq hn₀.2]
    have := vecFreq_eq hP (b j c)
    rw [hb] at this ⊢
    simp only at this ⊢
    rw [vecFreq_sub] at this
    linarith
  have hweight : ∀ j c, (Real.sqrt (((vecNum (b j c) * r : ℕ) : ℝ) * vecDen (b j c)))⁻¹ =
      (∏ p : P, primeHalf p ^ ((b j c) p).natAbs) * (Real.sqrt r)⁻¹ := by
    intro j c
    rw [← inv_sqrt_vecNum_mul_vecDen (b j c), ← mul_inv, ← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity)]
    congr 2
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [weightedMoment_notchWeight_eq hL0]
  simp_rw [hfreq]
  have hsum := sum_modeCoeff_mul_weight_general (n := n) hn₀ ε
  have hmainC : ((((1 + ε ^ 2) * (if vecOf P n = 0 then 1 else 0) +
      ε * (if vecOf P n = vecOf P n₀ then 1 else 0)) * ∏ p : P, (1 - primeHalf p ^ 2)) *
        (Real.sqrt r)⁻¹ : ℝ) * logWindow L =
      ∑ j ∈ bohrModes, ∑ c ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : P => bohrModes),
        (modeCoeff ε j c : ℂ) *
          ((((Real.sqrt (((vecNum (b j c) * r : ℕ) : ℝ) * vecDen (b j c)))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            logWindow L) := by
    rw [← hsum]
    simp_rw [hweight]
    push_cast
    rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    ring
  rw [hmainC, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ => ?_)
  rw [← mul_sub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime (vecNum (b j c) * r) (vecDen (b j c)) :=
    Nat.Coprime.mul_left (coprime_vecNum_vecDen hP (b j c)) (coprime_roughPart_vecDen hP hn (b j c))
  have h := hmain hL hδ hδ4 (Nat.mul_pos (vecNum_pos hP (b j c)) hr0) (vecDen_pos hP (b j c)) hcop
  push_cast at h ⊢
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (abs_nonneg _)

source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  set A := (Finset.range (N + 1)).filter (fun n => 1 ≤ n ∧ IsRoughAbove z n) with hA
  set B := Finset.Icc 1 z with hB
  have hz1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ z := by exact_mod_cast hz
  have hlogz : 0 < Real.log ((z : ℝ) + 1) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hS : Real.log ((z : ℝ) + 1) ≤ ∑ s ∈ B, (s : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    have h := log_add_one_le_harmonic z
    rw [harmonic_eq_sum_Icc] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h.trans (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => one_div _))
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ ∑ n ∈ A, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := Finset.sum_nonneg fun n _ => by positivity
  -- injectivity of `(n, s) ↦ n s`
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x : ℕ × ℕ => x.1 * x.2) (A ×ˢ B : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) := by
    rintro ⟨n, s⟩ hx ⟨n', s'⟩ hy h
    simp only [Finset.coe_product, Set.mem_prod, Finset.mem_coe, hA, hB, Finset.mem_filter,
      Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_range] at hx hy h
    obtain ⟨⟨-, hn1, hnr⟩, hs1, hsz⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨⟨-, hn1', hnr'⟩, hs1', hsz'⟩ := hy
    have hcop : ∀ {a b : ℕ}, 1 ≤ b → IsRoughAbove z b → 1 ≤ a → a ≤ z → a.Coprime b := by
      intro a b hb hbr ha haz
      refine Nat.coprime_of_dvd fun k hk hka hkb => ?_
      have hkle : k ≤ z := (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hka).trans haz
      have hmem : k ∈ b.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hk, hkb, by omega⟩
      have := hbr k hmem
      omega
    have h1 : s ∣ s' := (hcop hn1' hnr' hs1 hsz).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (h ▸ dvd_mul_left s n)
    have h2 : s' ∣ s := (hcop hn1 hnr hs1' hsz').dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (h.symm ▸ dvd_mul_left s' n')
    have hss : s = s' := Nat.dvd_antisymm h1 h2
    subst hss
    have hnn : n = n' := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right (by omega) h
    rw [hnn]
  have hprod : (∑ n ∈ A, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) * (∑ s ∈ B, (s : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ 1 + 2 * Real.log N := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    have e : ∑ n ∈ A, ∑ s ∈ B, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * (s : ℝ)⁻¹ =
        ∑ m ∈ (A ×ˢ B).image (fun x : ℕ × ℕ => x.1 * x.2), (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_image hinj, Finset.sum_product]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
      push_cast; rw [mul_inv]
    rw [e]
    have hsub : (A ×ˢ B).image (fun x : ℕ × ℕ => x.1 * x.2) ⊆ Finset.range (N * z + 1) := by
      intro m hm
      obtain ⟨⟨n, s⟩, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
      simp only [Finset.mem_product, hA, hB, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc,
        Finset.mem_range] at hx
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) hx.2.2))
    refine (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub fun m _ _ => by positivity).trans ?_
    refine (PrimeSmallDeviation.sum_range_inv_le (N * z)).trans ?_
    have hN1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hz.trans hzN
    have hzN' : (z : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hzN
    push_cast
    rw [Real.log_mul (by linarith) (by linarith)]
    have := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hzN'
    linarith
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hlogz]
  calc (∑ n ∈ A, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) * Real.log ((z : ℝ) + 1)
      ≤ (∑ n ∈ A, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) * ∑ s ∈ B, (s : ℝ)⁻¹ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS hA0
    _ ≤ 1 + 2 * Real.log N := hprod

Weil-positive and `lam(n) ≤ K (1 + Λ(n))` for every non-prime `n ≥ 2`, then the harmonic mass of
`lam` on the non-primes is `o(log N)`. -/

by
  refine le_antisymm (ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε _ => ?_) bot_le
  rw [zero_add, ← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
  have hεr : (0 : ℝ) < ε := hε
  set A : ℝ := (1 + |K| + 2 * c) / c with hAdef
  set B : ℝ := 16 * 1 ^ 2 / (c ^ 2 * ε) with hBdef
  obtain ⟨b, hcard, hsix, hbig, hb3⟩ := (eventually_card_window_ge.and
    (eventually_six_log_le.and ((eventually_ge_atTop ⌈A + B + 4⌉₊).and
      (eventually_ge_atTop 3)))).exists
  have hceil : A + B + 4 ≤ (b : ℝ) := (Nat.le_ceil _).trans (by exact_mod_cast hbig)
  have hbr : (3 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb3
  have hl : 0 < Real.log b := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by positivity
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by positivity
  have hb_le_sq : (b : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  -- choose the primes
  have hKle : primeCount b ≤ (window b).card := by
    have h := Nat.floor_le_of_le (n := (window b).card) hcard
    exact h
  obtain ⟨S, hSsub, hScard⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq hKle
  have hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime := fun p hp => (mem_window (hSsub hp)).1
  set N := ∏ p ∈ S, p with hNdef
  have hN : N ≠ 0 := prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun p hp => (hS p hp).ne_zero
  have hsq : Squarefree N := squarefree_prod_primes hS
  -- log N ≤ b²
  have hlogN : Real.log N ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hNdef, Nat.cast_prod, Real.log_prod (fun p hp => by
      exact_mod_cast (hS p hp).ne_zero)]
    calc ∑ p ∈ S, Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ ∑ _p ∈ S, 3 * Real.log b := by
          refine sum_le_sum fun p hp => ?_
          obtain ⟨hpr, -, hp3⟩ := mem_window (hSsub hp)
          calc Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((b : ℝ) ^ 3) :=
                Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hpr.pos) (by exact_mod_cast hp3)
            _ = 3 * Real.log b := by rw [Real.log_pow]; norm_num
      _ = (primeCount b : ℝ) * (3 * Real.log b) := by rw [sum_const, hScard, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          have := Nat.floor_le (show 0 ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 2 / (3 * Real.log b) by positivity)
          unfold primeCount
          rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at this
          linarith
  -- the product is at least b⁶
  have hQ : ((b : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ 3 ≤ setProduct S := by
    have hY : ∀ p ∈ S, (p : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 3 := fun p hp => by
      exact_mod_cast (mem_window (hSsub hp)).2.2
    refine le_trans ?_ (exp_le_setProduct hS hY)
    rw [hScard]
    calc ((b : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ 3 = Real.exp (6 * Real.log b) := by
          rw [show (6 : ℝ) * Real.log b = Real.log ((b : ℝ) ^ 6) by rw [Real.log_pow]; norm_num,
            Real.exp_log (by positivity)]; ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp ((primeCount b : ℝ) * ((b : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) / 4) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hsix
  -- the mean hypothesis on the divisors of N
  have hmeanN : ∀ n ∈ N.divisors, 3 ≤ n → c / Real.log n ≤ ∫ ω, X n ω ∂P := by
    intro n hn h3
    have hdn := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hn
    refine hmean n h3 (hsq.squarefree_of_dvd hdn) fun q hq hqn => ?_
    have hqS := mem_of_prime_dvd_prod hS hq (hqn.trans hdn)
    have hq2 : (b : ℝ) ^ 2 < q := by exact_mod_cast (mem_window (hSsub hqS)).2.1
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n by omega)
    have hlogn : Real.log n ≤ Real.log N :=
      Real.log_le_log hn0 (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hN) hdn)
    linarith
  have hsubset : {ω | ∀ S : Finset ℕ, (∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) →
      2 * sumN X (∏ p ∈ S, p) ω ≤
        (Real.log (∏ p ∈ S, p : ℕ) + K) * (∏ p ∈ S, p).divisors.card} ⊆
      {ω | 2 * sumN X N ω ≤ (Real.log N + K) * N.divisors.card} := fun ω hω => hω S hS
  refine (measure_mono hsubset).trans ?_
  have t1 : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have t2 : (1 + |K| + 2 * c) / c ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 2 := by rw [← hAdef]; linarith
  have t3 : 16 * 1 ^ 2 / (c ^ 2 * (ε : ℝ)) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ 2 := by rw [← hBdef]; linarith

    (card_divisors_prod_primes hS) (resonanceMass_half_prod_primes hS)
    (resonanceMass_one_prod_primes_le hS) hlogN hQ t1 t2 t3

/-- **Random log-rough prime systems are almost surely not Weil-positive.**  Let `X_n ∈ [0,1]` be
pairwise independent on the squarefree integers with `E X_n ≥ c / log n` for every squarefree
`n ≥ 3` whose prime factors all exceed `log n`.  Then almost surely no weights agreeing with
`X_n log n` on the squarefree integers are full-cone Weil-positive.  This covers Granville's
refinement of Cramér's model: integers coprime to the primes `≤ A(n)`, `A(n) ≤ log n`, are kept
with probability `(Q/φ(Q))/log n ≥ 1/log n`. -/

      |(∑ w ∈ rectZeros bottomHeight Y, (mult w : ℂ) * (testTwo N f P M w * gaussWeight T w)).re -

by
  classical
  set sf := suppIcc N f with hsf
  have hposf : ∀ n ∈ sf, 1 ≤ n := fun n hn => (mem_suppIcc.mp hn).1.1
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := hposf M hMmem
  have hP0 : 0 < P := hP.pos
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime P M := (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hP).mpr fun h =>
    absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h) (by omega)
  have hX₅ : ∀ w, dirPoly N f (1 - w) * ratPow P M w =
      famPoly sf (fun n => f n / n) (fun n => n * P) (fun _ => 1 * M) w := fun w => by
    rw [dirPoly_one_sub_eq_famPoly N f w, famPoly_mul_ratPow]
  have hX₆ : ∀ w, dirPoly N f w * ratPow P M w =
      famPoly sf f (fun _ => 1 * P) (fun n => n * M) w := fun w => by
    rw [dirPoly_eq_famPoly N f w, famPoly_mul_ratPow]
  have hint₅ : ∀ n ∈ sf, 1 * M ∣ n * P → n * P = P * (1 * M) := by
    intro n hn hdvd
    rw [one_mul] at hdvd ⊢
    have hMn : M ∣ n := hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hdvd
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (hposf n hn) hMn
    have hnM : n = M := le_antisymm (hsupp n hn) this
    rw [hnM, mul_comm]
  have hfil₅ : sf.filter (fun n => (fun _ : ℕ => 1 * M) n ∣ (fun n : ℕ => n * P) n) = {M} := by
    ext n
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hn, hdvd⟩
      have h := hint₅ n hn hdvd
      rw [one_mul, mul_comm P M] at h
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hP0 h
    · rintro rfl
      refine ⟨hMmem, ?_⟩
      simp only [one_mul]
      exact dvd_mul_right _ _
  obtain ⟨C₅, hC₅, T₅, h₅⟩ := exists_abs_re_zeroSum_deriv_famPoly_sub_le sf (fun n => f n / n)
    (fun n => n * P) (fun _ => 1 * M) (fun n hn => by have := hposf n hn; positivity)
    (fun _ _ => by omega) P hint₅
  obtain ⟨C₆, hC₆, T₆, h₆⟩ := exists_abs_re_zeroSum_deriv_one_sub_famPoly_le sf f
    (fun _ => 1 * P) (fun n => n * M) (fun _ _ => by omega)
    (fun n hn => by have := hposf n hn; positivity)
    (fun n hn hdvd => by
      rw [one_mul] at hdvd
      rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hP).mp hdvd with h | h
      · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (hposf n hn) h; have := hsupp n hn; omega
      · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h; omega)
  refine ⟨C₅ + C₆, by positivity, max T₅ T₆, fun T hT Y hY => ?_⟩
  have e₅ := h₅ T (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hT) Y hY
  have e₆ := h₆ T (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hT) Y hY
  rw [hfil₅, Finset.sum_singleton] at e₅
  set Z := rectZeros bottomHeight Y
  have hsplit : ∑ w ∈ Z, (mult w : ℂ) * (testTwo N f P M w * gaussWeight T w) =
      ∑ w ∈ Z, (mult w : ℂ) * (deriv riemannZeta w *
        famPoly sf (fun n => f n / n) (fun n => n * P) (fun _ => 1 * M) w * gaussWeight T w) -
      ∑ w ∈ Z, (mult w : ℂ) * (deriv riemannZeta (1 - w) *
        famPoly sf f (fun _ => 1 * P) (fun n => n * M) w * gaussWeight T w) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_
    rw [← hX₅, ← hX₆]
    unfold testTwo
    ring
  rw [hsplit, Complex.sub_re]
  set S₅ := (∑ w ∈ Z, (mult w : ℂ) * (deriv riemannZeta w *
        famPoly sf (fun n => f n / n) (fun n => n * P) (fun _ => 1 * M) w * gaussWeight T w)).re
  set S₆ := (∑ w ∈ Z, (mult w : ℂ) * (deriv riemannZeta (1 - w) *
        famPoly sf f (fun _ => 1 * P) (fun n => n * M) w * gaussWeight T w)).re
  set Mn := (∑ w ∈ Z, (mult w : ℂ) * (deriv riemannZeta w * ((P : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ w * gaussWeight T w)).re
  have key : S₅ - S₆ - f M / M * Mn = (S₅ - f M / M * Mn) - S₆ := by ring
  rw [key]
  calc |(S₅ - f M / M * Mn) - S₆| ≤ |S₅ - f M / M * Mn| + |S₆| := abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ C₅ * T * (Real.log T + 1) + C₆ * T * (Real.log T + 1) := add_le_add e₅ e₆
    _ = _ := by ring

by
  classical
  set d := WeilOneSided.coneDeviation lam with hddef
  have hd0 : d 0 = 0 := by simp [hddef, WeilOneSided.coneDeviation]
  -- the multiples series
  set u : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun e n => if e ∣ n then d n / n else 0 with hu
  have hus : ∀ e, 2 ≤ e → Summable (u e) := fun e he =>
    (hmult e he).of_norm_bounded fun n => by
      simp only [hu, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      split_ifs
      · rw [abs_div, Nat.abs_cast]
      · simp
  set U : ℕ → ℝ := fun e => if e = 1 then 0 else ∑' n, u e n with hU
  have hUlim : ∀ e, 1 ≤ e →
      Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), u e n) atTop (𝓝 (U e)) := by
    intro e he
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le he with rfl | he2
    · simp only [hU, if_true]
      refine ((tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mpr hT).congr fun k => ?_
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => by simp [hu]
    · simp only [hU, if_neg (show e ≠ 1 by omega)]
      exact (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mpr (hus e he2).hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
  -- `Γ_N = Σ_{e∣N} φ(e) U_e = 0`
  have hΓ0 : ∀ N, 2 ≤ N → ∑ e ∈ N.divisors, (Nat.totient e : ℝ) * U e = 0 := by
    intro N hN
    have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hΓlim : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), d n * Nat.gcd n N / n) atTop
        (𝓝 (∑ e ∈ N.divisors, (Nat.totient e : ℝ) * U e)) := by
      have h : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ∑ e ∈ N.divisors, (Nat.totient e : ℝ) *
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), u e n) atTop
          (𝓝 (∑ e ∈ N.divisors, (Nat.totient e : ℝ) * U e)) :=
        tendsto_finsetSum _ fun e he =>
          (hUlim e (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors he)).const_mul _
      refine h.congr fun k => ?_
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => mul_gcd_div_eq_sum_totient hN0 d n, Finset.sum_comm]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    have hT1 := (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mpr hT
    have hlaw : ∀ t : ℝ, t * (Real.sqrt N)⁻¹ * (∑ e ∈ N.divisors, (Nat.totient e : ℝ) * U e) ≤ 0 := by
      intro t
      have h := le_zero_of_tendsto_gcdTwist hW hd hN t
        (X := (1 + t ^ 2) * 0 + t * (Real.sqrt N)⁻¹ *
          (0 + ∑ e ∈ N.divisors, (Nat.totient e : ℝ) * U e))
        (((hT1.const_mul _).add ((hT1.add hΓlim).const_mul _)))
      linarith
    have hs : 0 < (Real.sqrt N)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < N)))
    have h1 := hlaw 1
    have h2 := hlaw (-1)
    nlinarith
  -- every `U_e` vanishes
  have hU0 : ∀ N, 1 ≤ N → U N = 0 := by
    intro N
    induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ N ih =>
      intro hN
      rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hN with rfl | hN2
      · simp [hU]
      have hsum := hΓ0 N hN2
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single N (fun e he hne => by
          rw [ih e (lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.divisor_le he) hne) (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors he),
            mul_zero])
          (fun h => absurd (Nat.mem_divisors_self N (by omega)) h)] at hsum
      have hφ : (Nat.totient N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (by omega)).ne'
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hsum).resolve_left hφ
  -- the coprime-filtered multiples sums
  set f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun m k => d (m * k) / ((m * k : ℕ) : ℝ) with hf
  have hfs : ∀ m, 2 ≤ m → Summable fun k => |f m k| := fun m hm => by
    have h := (hmult m hm).comp_injective (mul_right_injective₀ (show m ≠ 0 by omega))
    refine h.congr fun k => ?_
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hf]
    rw [if_pos (dvd_mul_right m k), abs_div, Nat.abs_cast]
  set Z : ℕ → Finset ℕ → ℝ := fun m S =>
    ∑' k, if (∀ p ∈ S, ¬ p ∣ k) then f m k else 0 with hZ

      Summable fun k => if (∀ p ∈ S, ¬ p ∣ k) then f m k else 0 := fun m hm S =>
    (hfs m hm).of_norm_bounded fun k => by
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      split_ifs
      · exact le_rfl
      · simp
  have hZ0 : ∀ m, 2 ≤ m → Z m ∅ = 0 := by
    intro m hm
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by omega
    have e : Z m ∅ = ∑' n, u m n := by

  funext n
  simp only [valuationPart, LSeries.convolution_def, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ab hab

    · subst h; rw [Nat.cast_zero, Real.zero_rpow (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    · exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by exact_mod_cast h) (by norm_num)
  · exact le_rfl

/-- `A_J = ∏_{p < L} p^J`. -/
def Apow (L J : ℕ) : ℕ := ∏ p ∈ L.primesBelow, p ^ J

/-- The large primes `L ≤ p ≤ y`. -/
def bigPrimes (L y : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := y.primesLE.filter (L ≤ ·)

/-- `B = ∏_{L ≤ p ≤ y} p`. -/
def Bprod (L y : ℕ) : ℕ := ∏ p ∈ bigPrimes L y, p

theorem prime_of_mem_bigPrimes {L y p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ bigPrimes L y) : p.Prime :=
  Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1

theorem le_of_mem_bigPrimes {L y p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ bigPrimes L y) : L ≤ p :=
  (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2

theorem Apow_ne_zero (L J : ℕ) : Apow L J ≠ 0 :=
  Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun _ hp => pow_ne_zero _ (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesBelow hp).ne_zero

theorem Bprod_ne_zero (L y : ℕ) : Bprod L y ≠ 0 :=
  Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun _ hp => (prime_of_mem_bigPrimes hp).ne_zero

theorem coprime_Apow_Bprod (L J y : ℕ) : (Apow L J).Coprime (Bprod L y) := by
  refine Nat.Coprime.prod_left fun p hp => Nat.Coprime.prod_right fun q hq => ?_
  have hp' := Nat.mem_primesBelow.mp hp
  have hq' := le_of_mem_bigPrimes hq
  exact Nat.Coprime.pow_left _ ((Nat.coprime_primes hp'.2 (prime_of_mem_bigPrimes hq)).mpr
    (by omega))

theorem Apow_mul (L a b : ℕ) : Apow L a * Apow L b = Apow L (a + b) := by
  unfold Apow; rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun p _ => (pow_add _ _ _).symm

theorem Apow_dvd {L a b : ℕ} (h : a ≤ b) : Apow L a ∣ Apow L b := by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  rw [← Apow_mul]; exact Dvd.intro _ rfl

theorem lt_of_prime_dvd_Apow {L J p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (h : p ∣ Apow L J) : p < L := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := (Nat.prime_iff.mp hp).dvd_finsetProd_iff _ |>.mp h
  have hq' := Nat.mem_primesBelow.mp hq
  have := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hq'.2).mp (hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hpq)
  omega

theorem factorization_Apow (L J p : ℕ) :
    (Apow L J).factorization p = if p ∈ L.primesBelow then J else 0 := by
  unfold Apow
  rw [Nat.factorization_prod fun q hq => pow_ne_zero _ (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesBelow hq).ne_zero,
    Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  simp_rw [Nat.factorization_pow, Finsupp.smul_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
    · rw [(Nat.prime_of_mem_primesBelow h).factorization_self, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    · intro q hq hqp
      rw [(Nat.prime_of_mem_primesBelow hq).factorization, Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg hqp,
        smul_zero]
    · intro h'; exact absurd h h'
  · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun q hq => ?_
    rw [(Nat.prime_of_mem_primesBelow hq).factorization, Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg, smul_zero]
    rintro rfl; exact h hq

/-- On divisors of `A_J`, `φ(k) = k^{−½}` and `g(k) = 1/k`. -/
theorem cmul_wL_of_dvd_Apow {L J k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (h : k ∣ Apow L J) :
    cmul (wL L) k = (k : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
  have hk' : (k : ℝ) = ∏ p ∈ k.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ^ k.factorization p := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hk]
    rw [Nat.cast_finsuppProd, Finsupp.prod, Nat.support_factorization]
    push_cast; rfl
  rw [hk', ← Real.finsetProd_rpow _ _ fun p _ => by positivity]
  unfold cmul
  rw [Finsupp.prod, Nat.support_factorization]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
  have hpp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
  have hpL := lt_of_prime_dvd_Apow hpp ((Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp).trans h)
  unfold wL
  rw [if_pos hpL, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity),
    ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity), mul_comm]

theorem gA_wL_of_dvd_Apow {L J k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (h : k ∣ Apow L J) :
    gA (wL L) k = 1 / k := by
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
  rw [gA_apply hk, cmul_wL_of_dvd_Apow hk h, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_sub hk0]
  norm_num
  rw [Real.rpow_neg_one]

/-- `h(p) = 2` and `H(p) = 2 + p^{−½}` at the large primes. -/
theorem hA_wL_prime {L p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hL : L ≤ p) : hA (wL L) p = 2 := by
  rw [hA_apply, hp.divisors, Finset.sum_pair (Ne.symm hp.one_lt.ne'), cmul_one]
  have := cmul_prime_pow (wL L) hp 1
  rw [pow_one] at this
  rw [this]
  unfold wL; rw [if_neg (by omega)]; norm_num

theorem HA_wL_prime {L p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hL : L ≤ p) :
    HA (wL L) p = 2 + 1 / Real.sqrt p := by
  rw [HA_apply, hp.divisors, Finset.sum_pair (Ne.symm hp.one_lt.ne'), Nat.div_one,
    Nat.div_self hp.pos, hA_wL_prime hp hL, gA_apply one_ne_zero, cmul_one, gA_apply hp.ne_zero]
  have := cmul_prime_pow (wL L) hp 1

/-!
# The staircase assembly inequality

The certificate for the constrained restricted Weil form replaces the multiplier `m_S` by a
staircase `Σ_b c_b 1_{B_b} + c_∞ 1_{rest}` with band projections `P_b`, splits a test `x = y + z`
into a finite-dimensional low part `y` and a high part `z` orthogonal to it, and uses three inputs:

* the low block is bounded below, `q(y) ≥ a ‖y‖²` (the certified finite eigenvalue);
* the high part has little mass in the finite bands, `Σ_b ‖P_b z‖² ≤ M ‖z‖²` (Taylor localisation);
* the band constants are bounded, `|c_b − c_∞| ≤ D`.

Then, writing `q(v, w)` for the staircase bilinear form,

```
  q(x) ≥ a ‖y‖² − 2 D √M ‖y‖ ‖z‖ + (c_∞ − (c_∞ − c_min)⁺ M) ‖z‖²,
```

and if `κ ≤ a`, `κ ≤ c_∞ − (c_∞ − c_min)⁺ M` and `D² M ≤ (a − κ)(c − κ)` then `q(x) ≥ κ ‖x‖²`.
This file proves that assembly in an abstract real inner product space, for any finite family of
mutually orthogonal self-adjoint idempotents.  Nothing here is specific to the Weil form; it is the
linear-algebra skeleton of the certificate, so that the only unformalised input is the finite
numerical block.
-/

open Finset
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace RHTower

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

/-- A finite family of mutually orthogonal self-adjoint idempotents (band projections). -/
structure BandProjections (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (n : ℕ) where
  P : Fin n → E →ₗ[ℝ] E
  self_adjoint : ∀ b (v w : E), ⟪P b v, w⟫ = ⟪v, P b w⟫
  idem : ∀ b (v : E), P b (P b v) = P b v
  orth : ∀ b c, b ≠ c → ∀ v : E, P b (P c v) = 0

namespace BandProjections

variable {n : ℕ} (B : BandProjections E n)

theorem inner_P_P (b : Fin n) (v w : E) : ⟪B.P b v, B.P b w⟫ = ⟪v, B.P b w⟫ := by
  rw [B.self_adjoint, B.idem]

theorem inner_P_P_ne {b c : Fin n} (hbc : b ≠ c) (v w : E) : ⟪B.P b v, B.P c w⟫ = 0 := by
  rw [B.self_adjoint, B.orth b c hbc, inner_zero_right]

theorem inner_P_self_nonneg (b : Fin n) (v : E) : 0 ≤ ⟪v, B.P b v⟫ := by
  rw [← B.inner_P_P]; exact real_inner_self_nonneg

/-- `‖Σ_b P_b v‖² = Σ_b ⟪v, P_b v⟫`. -/
theorem norm_sum_P_sq (v : E) : ‖∑ b, B.P b v‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) = ∑ b, ⟪v, B.P b v⟫ := by
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, sum_inner]
  refine sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
  rw [inner_sum, sum_eq_single b]
  · exact B.inner_P_P b v v
  · intro c _ hcb
    exact B.inner_P_P_ne (Ne.symm hcb) v v
  · intro h; exact absurd (mem_univ b) h

/-- Bessel: `Σ_b ⟪v, P_b v⟫ ≤ ‖v‖²`. -/
theorem sum_inner_P_le (v : E) : ∑ b, ⟪v, B.P b v⟫ ≤ ‖v‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
  have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖v - ∑ b, B.P b v‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) := by positivity
  have hexp : ‖v - ∑ b, B.P b v‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) = ‖v‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) - ∑ b, ⟪v, B.P b v⟫ := by
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real, B.norm_sum_P_sq, inner_sum]
    ring
  linarith

/-- The staircase bilinear form `q(v, w) = Σ_b c_b ⟪v, P_b w⟫ + c_∞ (⟪v, w⟫ − Σ_b ⟪v, P_b w⟫)`. -/
noncomputable def staircaseForm (c : Fin n → ℝ) (cinf : ℝ) (v w : E) : ℝ :=
  ∑ b, c b * ⟪v, B.P b w⟫ + cinf * (⟪v, w⟫ - ∑ b, ⟪v, B.P b w⟫)

theorem staircaseForm_symm (c : Fin n → ℝ) (cinf : ℝ) (v w : E) :
    B.staircaseForm c cinf v w = B.staircaseForm c cinf w v := by
  unfold staircaseForm
  have h : ∀ b, ⟪v, B.P b w⟫ = ⟪w, B.P b v⟫ := fun b => by
    rw [← B.self_adjoint, real_inner_comm]
  simp only [h, real_inner_comm v w]

theorem staircaseForm_add_left (c : Fin n → ℝ) (cinf : ℝ) (v v' w : E) :
    B.staircaseForm c cinf (v + v') w = B.staircaseForm c cinf v w + B.staircaseForm c cinf v' w := by
  unfold staircaseForm
  simp only [inner_add_left, mul_add, sum_add_distrib]
  ring

theorem staircaseForm_add_right (c : Fin n → ℝ) (cinf : ℝ) (v w w' : E) :
    B.staircaseForm c cinf v (w + w') = B.staircaseForm c cinf v w + B.staircaseForm c cinf v w' := by
  rw [B.staircaseForm_symm, B.staircaseForm_add_left, B.staircaseForm_symm c cinf w,
    B.staircaseForm_symm c cinf w']

/-- Expansion of the form on a sum. -/
theorem staircaseForm_add_add (c : Fin n → ℝ) (cinf : ℝ) (y z : E) :
    B.staircaseForm c cinf (y + z) (y + z) =
      B.staircaseForm c cinf y y + 2 * B.staircaseForm c cinf y z + B.staircaseForm c cinf z z := by
  rw [B.staircaseForm_add_left, B.staircaseForm_add_right, B.staircaseForm_add_right,
    B.staircaseForm_symm c cinf z y]
  ring

/-- **High block.**  If `Σ_b ⟪z, P_b z⟫ ≤ M ‖z‖²`, then
`q(z, z) ≥ (c_∞ − (c_∞ − c_min)⁺ M) ‖z‖²` where `c_min ≤ c_b` for all `b`. -/
theorem staircaseForm_self_ge_high (c : Fin n → ℝ) (cinf cmin M : ℝ) (hc : ∀ b, cmin ≤ c b)
    (z : E) (hM : ∑ b, ⟪z, B.P b z⟫ ≤ M * ‖z‖ ^ (2 : ℕ)) :
    (cinf - max (cinf - cmin) 0 * M) * ‖z‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ B.staircaseForm c cinf z z := by
  unfold staircaseForm
  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hsum : ∑ b, (cinf - c b) * ⟪z, B.P b z⟫ ≤ max (cinf - cmin) 0 * ∑ b, ⟪z, B.P b z⟫ := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    refine sum_le_sum (fun b _ => ?_)
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (B.inner_P_self_nonneg b z)
    exact le_trans (by linarith [hc b]) (le_max_left _ _)
